items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: Jim Taylor, he was a jazz promoter. He had the Hot Jazz Society.

ctx.x: Jim Taylor, he was a jazz promoter. He had the Hot Jazz Society. And he's not into any of that anymore. And he was into recording. And he tried to bring back the McKinney Cotton Pickers, called it Little McKinney, New McKinney Cotton Pickers. But it was, actually it was only two men he started with that played with the McKinney Cotton Pickers. That was the guitar player, the banjo player that died and was doing the singing.
Was that before Dave Wilber or after?
